summary: This is a React component that renders a card footer section. It accepts styling options like text alignment, weight, and color, combines them into CSS class names using a utility function, and renders a div with those classes plus any custom className or inline styles passed in.

explanations.6: Props is extending CardTextOptions, which means this Props interface inherits all the properties from CardTextOptions and adds its own properties (className, style, children) on top.
explanations.18: Setting italic to false by default means if the caller doesn't provide an italic prop, it will be treated as false automatically.
explanations.24: buildTextClasses is a utility function being called with all the text styling options; it returns an object with multiple CSS class strings (text, textColor, etc.) that will be applied to the footer.
explanations.34: styles.truncate is being passed as a second argument to buildTextClasses, likely telling it where to find the CSS module class for text truncation if needed.
explanations.38: clsx is a utility that combines multiple class names together, filtering out any that are undefined or empty, so only valid classes end up in the final className string.
